verdict.rationale: The evidence describes AI features: summarizing conversations, automating repetitive work, customer-facing booking and qualification agents, voice agents, and autonomous CRM record updates. None of it documents a way for users to operate Salesmate by issuing natural-language commands. These are adjacent AI capabilities, not a natural-language command interface for the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
